items.claim: Michael Oliveira is an insanely fast and busy striker who overwhelms opponents with high volume.
items.quote: Michael Oliveira is an insanely fast and busy striker.

items.claim: Michael Oliveira possesses fantastic power and can put opponents to sleep when landing clean during high-volume exchanges.
Michael Oliveira's takedown defense is okay but relatively untested.
items.quote: His takedown defense is just okay, but it's relatively untested in that department.

items.claim: Michael Oliveira is coming off a quick Contender Series knockout.
items.quote: He is coming off that quick Contender Series knockout

items.claim: Oban Elliott has 15 full minutes of cardio and plenty of tools in the bag.
items.quote: Oban Elliott, a well-rounded guy with 15 full minutes of cardio

items.claim: Oban Elliott has okay takedown defense and has grappling holes that were recently exploited against Jonathan Micallef.
items.quote: if he is taken down, there are definitely grappling holes, and those holes were just recently exploited against Jonathan Micallef

items.claim: Ludovit Klein is a smooth, fast, and accurate striker who keeps fights technical and hides kicks behind the jab.
items.quote: Ludovit Klein is a very good striker. He's smooth, he's fast, he's accurate

items.claim: Ludovit Klein has a solid 76% takedown defense.
items.quote: He has a solid 76% takedown defense

items.claim: Ludovit Klein is coming off an ankle injury win over Mateusz Rebecki where he survived the third round on his back.
items.quote: He's coming off that ankle-breaking win over Mateusz Rebecki

items.claim: Tofiq Musayev throws everything with 100% intent and hunts for finishes on the feet and ground.
items.quote: He throws everything with 100% intent and he will hunt for finishes on the feet, on the ground

items.claim: Tofiq Musayev is coming off a wrestle-heavy win over Ignacio Bahamondes where he was knocked down but put up 8 minutes of control time.
items.quote: He is coming off the wrestle-heavy win over Ignacio Bahamondes where he was knocked down, but he was able to survive and ultimately put up 8 minutes of control on the board.
